note: Five independent business-role examples, not exhaustive healthcare membership or clinical recommendations. Only public corporate material archived; no patient records, test results, enquiries or bookings accessed. No weights or historical membership inferred.
comparison_note: Hospitals, laboratories, pharmaceutical products, contract services and device consumables have different economics and regulatory exposures. This is a business-role map, not a homogeneous revenue-growth or valuation peer group, or a clinical-quality ranking.

members.rationale: Hospital operations establish care-delivery exposure. Network facilities include varying ownership and operating arrangements; network size is not direct ownership of every property, current occupancy or patient volume growth. Homecare and pathology activity are not ignored.
members.identity_source: Current official Nifty constituent archive; not historical membership

members.rationale: Diagnostic testing services establish pathology exposure. Test capability and laboratory reach are not current patient-volume growth or a clinical accuracy comparison; the listed company is not treated as a drug manufacturer.
